name: Hungary

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 91,260 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 9,514,251. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 32,150 active. CIA Factbook 2025 ~30,000 (low); Hungarian Defence Forces infobox 41,600 (high, broader definition).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 32,150 minus infantry P roles (6,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Hungary 1941-44 (~1 million mobilized from ~14 million incl. annexed areas, ~7%) at the high end; low for an all-volunteer force.

ships.note: Anchor 8: Landlocked: Danube river flotilla patrol boats only; value describes those small craft.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 313,485,949,133 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 9,514,251 = 32,949. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 391,612,678,492 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 313,485,949,133 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.04% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.12% in 2024, 1.32% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 23.0% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Net exporter of grain and meat.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 4,572,050 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.582% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 51,045. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Rheinmetall Zalaegerszeg Lynx plant (2024). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Hungarian_Ground_Forces)

roadKm.note: As quoted: 210,791 km of which 77,087 paved (2018).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 8,037 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Landlocked; CIA Factbook lists 1 Hungarian-flag vessel (2023).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1: familiar terrain and local supply; open Pannonian plain gives little depth.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:HUN. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Hungarian Ground Forces equipment list and active Hungarian military aircraft list; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Landlocked: ships tech describes river craft only.
